name: 0.20mm Non-planar top @BBL P1S
description: 0.20mm Standard tuning for P1S with curved top shells; auto chooses the shell count (2 to 6) and pattern for each curved area, with ironing left off. Thin curved parts (up to 3 mm) print in curved layers throughout on meshes with holes; closed meshes keep planar interiors. Uses the bundled bambu-p1s head.
